title: Restorative Response Guide: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
audience: Leaders and peer support after an incident
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Ask the seal change crew what they need before anything else.

items.text: The export holds no information about the people affected. Every need here is a question to ask, or the organisation's own answer.

items.question: How is the seal change crew, now that their job is at the centre of the investigation?
items.why: The work order shows the pump went back into service without a test [EVD-0001].
items.to: Line leader, with a peer supporter

items.question: What do you need from us now, and from whom?
items.why: Only the people involved can say.

items.question: What do you want to know about the investigation and how your account will be used?
items.why: The findings rest on records of their job [EVD-0001].

items.text: Meeting these needs is the organisation's obligation. It also owes the crew a return-to-service checklist, which the procedure index lacked [EVD-0002].

items.lesson: No checklist said what had to be done before a pump returned to service.
items.explanation: The procedure index has no return-to-service entry [EVD-0002].

items.lesson: Seals were bought locally without a specification.

items.text: Treat the seal change crew as possible second victims and offer them peer support.
Keep support apart from the investigation, and say so at the start.

limits: The synthetic export holds nothing about the people involved.
